systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST)
Unlocking Data Initiative Malawi team, in development; operational ownership to pass to the Centre for Educational Research and Training (CERT), University of Malawi
systems.tiers: not stated; a central searchable portal for datasets from MoEST, the gender ministry, the National Statistical Office, development partners and academia

note: EMIS is named as the ministry's largest foundational-learning dataset with no description of who enters what or when, so it is unclassified and gives no fact. The document also states that in 2023/24 93 per cent of the basic-education recurrent budget went to teacher salaries, leaving almost nothing for EMIS operations, and recommends web-based and mobile data collection as a priority not yet done.
